title: Evolving Decoding Algorithms for Quantum Error Correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.25880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum computation entails robustness engineering: a noisy quantum state is measured continuously, and a classical algorithm (the decoder) must infer corrections that reliably remove the noise, fast enough to keep up. We write several published belief-propagation (BP) decoders for quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes in a Domain-Specific Language (DSL), and search over it with grammatical evolution. Written in the language, the published decoders show their parameters in plain view, allowing us to re-parameterise BP+OSD (ordered statistics decoding) and BP+LSD (localized statistics decoding) decoders with damping, before any search, making each 17.1--41.0$\times$ faster at a higher error rate, and BP+OSD-0 about 103 faster than the ldpc package's version tuned on the [[72,12,6]] bivariate-bicycle code. Evolution over the language finds decoders that improve the time-error front. One makes 23% fewer logical errors than BP+OSD

translated_title: 面向量子纠错的进化式解码算法
translated_abstract: 量子计算需要鲁棒性工程：含噪声的量子态被持续测量，而一个经典算法（解码器）必须推断出能可靠消除噪声的校正操作，且速度必须足够快以跟上测量节奏。我们用领域特定语言（DSL）重写了多个已发表的用于量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码的置信传播（BP）解码器，并采用语法进化在该语言上进行搜索。用该语言编写后，已发表解码器的参数一目了然，使我们能够在搜索之前就用阻尼对BP+OSD（有序统计解码）和BP+LSD（局部统计解码）解码器进行重新参数化，使每个解码器在更高错误率下提速17.1至41.0倍，而BP+OSD-0在[[72,12,6]]双变量自行车码上比ldpc软件包中调优的版本快约103倍。对该语言的进化搜索找到了改进时间-错误率前沿的解码器，其中一个解码器比BP+OSD少产生23%的逻辑错误。
tldr: 本文将qLDPC码的置信传播解码器重写为领域特定语言并用语法进化搜索，通过阻尼重参数化使解码器提速17.1至41倍（BP+OSD-0提速约103倍），且进化出的解码器比BP+OSD减少23%的逻辑错误。
